days.title: Heart of the Wilderness and Historic Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Cicogna
stops.detail: Today in Val Grande there is only one inhabited center: Cicogna (a hamlet of Cossogno) where there are 17 inhabitants.

stops.name: Pogallo
stops.detail: At the beginning of the twentieth century in Pogallo, an alpine pasture located in the valley of the same name, there was a great development due to the production of timber coming from the deforestation that took place in Val Grande.

stops.name: Sutermeister
stops.detail: The connection between Pogallo and Cicogna, previously very difficult, was made suitable for timber carts thanks to a new mule track, called "Sutermeister" in honor of the engineer, which thanks to daring passages carved into the rock halves the travel time.

days.title: Central Nature Reserves and Peaks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Cima Pedum
stops.detail: The Val Grande Nature Reserve, the innermost area of the integral nature reserve, includes Cima Pedum, although the most sought-after peaks by hikers and nature lovers are the surrounding mountains.

stops.name: Cima Sasso
stops.detail: Without too much difficulty you can reach Cima Sasso, although knowledge of the surrounding territory is recommended, while the remaining part of the ridge is recommended for experienced and accompanied hikers.
